item.title: About
item.description: Hi, I’m Piotr! 👋 I am a husband to a renowned philosopher, Karolina Krzyżanowska, and also a software engineer at Viasat. I live in the lovely city of Warsaw Leuven Bergen Munich Amsterdam.
